details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that silently enrols the user's WhatsApp account into the author's channel. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket() schedules setTimeout(..., 90000) which issues a w:mex WhatsApp query with query id FOLLOW for the hardcoded newsletter JID 120363342976800779@newsletter (hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029VaranC0KmCPQCHryFs2C), so every socket the application creates subscribes the account to that channel; failures are swallowed in an empty catch. lib/Utils/messages.js hardcodes the same newsletterJid together with newsletterName "z4ph" into message context/quote metadata, attributing forwarded content to that channel. The package's only lifecycle hook (preinstall "node./engine-requirements.js") merely checks the Node.js major version and contacts nothing. No credential, token or environment exfiltration and no non-WhatsApp network destinations were found; the sole child_process use is ffmpeg for video thumbnail extraction.
